xsec_sources: 1902.00134 Tables 8,9,13: l+nuH 0.104, l-nuH 0.0666, llH 0.0331 pb per lepton flavour
yield_estimate: ESTIMATE: N_H ~1.9e8 (3000 fb-1) / 2.5e8 (4000 fb-1) from sigma_tot ~62.1 pb; BR(H->dark)=1e-3 gives ~1.9e5 produced. Lepton-tagged VH (e,mu): 0.407 pb -> ~1.2e3 events for BR=1e-3, ~120 after O(10%) acceptance (2512.24814 Sec V Fig 13). ggF via Run-3 displaced-jet trigger (eff 0.4-1%, 2409.10806 Sec 4, H->SS, UNVERIFIED for dark showers): ~750-1900 triggered events at BR=1e-3. HT>900 trigger keeps only 3.5e-3 of ggF (2307.04847).
backgrounds: Heavy-flavour hadron decays (dominant in 2512.24814), K_S/Lambda, photon conversions and material interactions (same mass range as 2-5 GeV mesons), random track crossings growing with PU, Z/W+HF jets and ttbar in VH(l). >=2 DV + lepton is near background-free (2107.06092: 1.30+-0.08+-0.27 bkg, 0 obs); single-DV/ggF is background-limited (2409.10806: 3.34+-1.28 bkg).
trigger: Run-3 CMS displaced-jet HLT (HT>430 GeV + 2 tagged jets; L1 HT>240+mu6) eff ~0.4-1% for H->SS (2409.10806). Phase-2 L1 tracks pT>2 GeV, but baseline is prompt-only (tight tracks die beyond a few mm, 1705.04321). Displaced L1 vertexing exists only as a simulation feasibility study (INSPIRE 2908980). Phase-2 L1 jet seeds at PU140: single 173, dijet 136, quad 72, HT 350 GeV, with a same-z-vertex requirement built from tracks with Lxy<1 cm (2003.03943 quoting L1 TDR); may be raised at PU200. VH(l) single/double-lepton triggers are robust.
pileup: PU 140-200 raises random displaced-track crossings and dilutes prompt-veto variables (PU_dz, alpha3D). The 2512.24814 projection did not simulate PU. Size of the effect is UNVERIFIED for Phase-2.
detector_upgrades: Help: CMS L1 track trigger (pT>2 GeV), MTD ~30 ps MIP timing for PU rejection (2003.03943), finer tracker granularity; ATLAS ITk/HGTD analogous. Limit: prompt-only baseline L1 tracking, higher L1 jet/HT thresholds at PU200, HLT displaced-tracking CPU cost.
systematics: Signal: displaced-track/vertex reconstruction efficiency (dominant, 2107.06092 Sec 7), JES 5-10%, PU 1-8%, tagger modelling 4-14% (2409.10806 Table 2). Background: data-driven ABCD, 21% (2107.06092) to ~38% (2409.10806). Dark-shower hadronization modelling dominates the interpretation. 2512.24814 includes no systematics.
projection_docs: 2512.24814 (pheno, 3000 fb-1, BR down to O(1e-4) in tracker; no PU, LO bb bkg only, no systematics, optimistic dijet 70/40 GeV trigger)
2307.04847 (CMS EJ recast to Higgs portal, 3000 fb-1 statistics-only, BR~1%)
hl_specific_advantage: Phase-2 L1 track trigger (first hardware access to track multiplicity and displacement) and MTD timing. ~20-30x Run-2 Higgs statistics matters mainly in the background-free VH(l) >=2-DV channel, where reach scales ~L.
main_obstacle: Triggering ggF/VBF Higgs->soft displaced dark showers at PU200: Run-3 displaced-jet triggers keep only ~0.4-1% of H->SS, and the needed L1 displaced-track/vertex seed is not baseline. Second: low-mass (2-5 GeV) DV backgrounds (K_S, material, B hadrons) prevent background-free counting.
caveats: Phase-2 L1 menu thresholds are secondary-sourced via 2003.03943; the TDR (CERN-LHCC-2020-004) could not be downloaded.
Run-3 displaced-jet trigger efficiency is for H->SS two-body decays; dark-shower efficiency UNVERIFIED.
Status and region of the ATLAS Higgs-portal dark-jet search (INSPIRE 3201494) not verified beyond the proceeding abstract.
Residual novelty is experimental implementation only (a pheno projection 2512.24814 exists).
Acceptance values (O(10%)) taken from a Delphes-level study without PU.
